$comment: Logo frames on the cover. Images are fitted inside a frame preserving aspect ratio; a frame is never resized by its contents, so the layout cannot shift. `panel` names a white backing shape that exists in the golden deck for this frame - it is hidden when the frame has been moved away from it, or when no logo is supplied, so an empty or orphaned white box never prints.

clientLogo.note: Upper left, aligned to the title's left edge (x=48). No native panel on this cover; region verified empty - cover text tops out at y=343.

presenterLogo.note: White panel, lower right of cover.

clientLogo.note: Upper left, aligned to the title's left edge (x=48). The deck's own 226x64 panel is misaligned with the text column and too small, so the frame is enlarged and that panel suppressed.

presenterLogo.note: White panel, lower right of cover.
